title: Fake bullions
statementMd:
In Isart people don't die. There are $*n*$ gangs of criminals. The $*i*$-th gang contains $*s*_{*i*}$ evil people numerated from $0$ to $*s*_{*i*} - 1$. Some of these people took part in a big mine robbery and picked **one** gold bullion each (these people are given in the input). That happened $10^{100}$ years ago and then all of the gangs escaped to a remote area, far from towns.

During the years, they were copying some gold bullions according to an organized plan in order to not get arrested. They constructed a **tournament** directed graph (a graph where there is exactly one directed edge between every pair of vertices) of gangs (the graph is given in the input). In this graph an edge from $*u*$ to $*v*$ means that in the $*i*$-th hour the person ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/61bc705a3383634b25a92745a03168debb353b98.png) of the gang $*u*$ can send a fake gold bullion to person ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adfa7cc8232689d97997079c9084a5ededa2f389.png) of gang $*v*$. He sends it if he has some bullion (real or fake), while the receiver doesn't have any. Thus, at any moment each of the gangsters has zero or one gold bullion. Some of them have real bullions, and some of them have fake ones.

In the beginning of this year, the police has finally found the gangs, but they couldn't catch them, as usual. The police decided to open a jewelry store so that the gangsters would sell the bullions. Thus, every gangster that has a bullion (fake or real) will try to sell it. If he has a real gold bullion, he sells it without problems, but if he has a fake one, there is a choice of two events that can happen:

- The person sells the gold bullion successfully.
- The person is arrested by police.

The power of a gang is the number of people in it that successfully sold their bullion. After all selling is done, the police arrests $*b*$ gangs out of *top* gangs. Sort the gangs by powers, we call the first $*a*$ gang *top* gangs(you can sort the equal powers in each order). Consider all possible results of selling fake gold bullions and all possible choice of $*b*$ gangs among the *top* gangs. Count the number of different sets of these $*b*$ gangs modulo $10^{9} + 7$. Two sets $*X*$ and $*Y*$ are considered different if some gang is in $*X*$ and isn't in $*Y*$.

## Input

The first line contains four integers $*n*$, $*a*$ and $*b*$ ($1 ≤ *b* ≤ *a* ≤ *n* ≤ 5·10^{3}$) — the number of gangs, the constants $*a*$ and $*b*$ from the statement.

Then $*n*$ lines follow, each line contains a string of size $*n*$ consisting of zeros and ones. The $*j*$-th character in the $*i*$-th of these lines is equal to $1$, then the vertex $*i*$ have a directed edge to the vertex $*j*$. It is guaranteed that $*a*_{*ii*} = 0$ and $*a*_{*ij*} + *a*_{*ji*} = 1$ if $*i* ≠ *j*$.

Then $*n*$ lines follow, each line starts with the integer $*s*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 2·10^{6}$) — the number of gangsters in the $*i*$-th gang, and then contains a string of zeros and ones with length $*s*_{*i*}$. The $*j*$-th character is $0$ if the $*j*$-th person of the $*i*$-th gang had a real gold bullion initially, otherwise it is $1$. It is guaranteed that the sum of $*s*_{*i*}$ does not exceed $2·10^{6}$.

## Output

Print single integer: the number of different sets of $*b*$ gangs the police can arrest modulo $10^{9} + 7$.
statementZhMd:
在 Isart，人们不会死亡。有 $*n*$ 个犯罪团伙。第 $*i*$ 个团伙包含 $*s*_{*i*}$ 名坏人，编号为 $0$ 到 $*s*_{*i*} - 1$。其中一些人参与了一次大型矿井抢劫，并且每人捡到了一根金条（这些人的信息会在输入中给出）。那已经是 $10^{100}$ 年前的事了，之后所有团伙都逃到了远离城镇的偏远地区。

多年来，他们按照有组织的计划复制了一些金条，以免被逮捕。他们构造了一个由团伙组成的**竞赛图**（一种图，其中每对顶点之间恰好有一条有向边；该图会在输入中给出）。在这张图中，从 $*u*$ 指向 $*v*$ 的边表示，在第 $*i*$ 个小时，团伙 $*u*$ 中的 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/61bc705a3383634b25a92745a03168debb353b98.png) 可以将一根假金条发送给团伙 $*v*$ 中的 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/adfa7cc8232689d97997079c9084a5ededa2f389.png)。当且仅当发送者拥有某根金条（真金条或假金条），且接收者没有金条时，他才会发送。因此，在任意时刻，每个团伙成员都拥有零根或一根金条。其中一些人拥有真金条，另一些人拥有假金条。

今年年初，警方终于找到了这些团伙，但和往常一样，他们没能抓住这些人。警方决定开一家珠宝店，以便团伙成员出售金条。因此，每个拥有金条（假金条或真金条）的成员都会尝试将其出售。如果他拥有真金条，那么可以顺利卖出；但如果他拥有假金条，则可能发生以下两种情况之一：

- 该成员成功卖出金条。
- 该成员被警方逮捕。

一个团伙的势力是该团伙中成功卖出金条的人数。所有出售行为完成后，警方会从 *top* 个团伙中逮捕 $*b*$ 个团伙。按照势力对团伙进行排序，我们称排在前 $*a*$ 位的团伙为 *top* 个团伙（势力相同的团伙可以按任意顺序排列）。考虑所有可能的假金条出售结果，以及从 *top* 个团伙中选择 $*b*$ 个团伙的所有可能方式，求不同的这 $*b*$ 个团伙的集合数量，结果对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模。如果某个团伙属于集合 $*X*$ 但不属于集合 $*Y*$，则认为集合 $*X*$ 和 $*Y*$ 不同。

## 输入格式

第一行包含四个整数 $*n*$、$*a*$ 和 $*b*$（$1 ≤ *b* ≤ *a* ≤ *n* ≤ 5·10^{3}$）——团伙数量，以及题目描述中的常数 $*a*$ 和 $*b*$。

接下来有 $*n*$ 行，每行包含一个长度为 $*n*$ 的由 0 和 1 组成的字符串。若这些行中第 $*i*$ 行的第 $*j*$ 个字符等于 1，则顶点 $*i*$ 有一条指向顶点 $*j*$ 的有向边。保证 $*a*_{*ii*} = 0$，且当 $*i* ≠ *j*$ 时，满足 $*a*_{*ij*} + *a*_{*ji*} = 1$。

接下来有 $*n*$ 行。每行首先包含整数 $*s*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *s*_{*i*} ≤ 2·10^{6}$）——第 $*i*$ 个团伙中的成员数量，随后包含一个长度为 $*s*_{*i*}$ 的由 0 和 1 组成的字符串。若第 $*j*$ 个字符为 0，则表示第 $*i*$ 个团伙的第 $*j*$ 名成员最初拥有一根真金条，否则表示他最初没有真金条。保证所有 $*s*_{*i*}$ 的总和不超过 $2·10^{6}$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数：警方能够逮捕的不同 $*b*$ 个团伙集合的数量，结果对 $10^{9} + 7$ 取模。
